gate_contract.criterion: A frozen workload/configuration suite records cycles, transfers, cache/local-memory use and computation counts with warm-up and repeat policy.
gate_contract.verification: Reproducible benchmark manifests, raw samples and analysis

obligations.requirement: P04 supplies accepted native tiny-model inference and frozen references.
obligations.assessment: P04 is complete with passing A01/A02/A03 reports at their recorded source identities. P05 is independent; the staged P01 vendor blocker is preserved.

obligations.requirement: Freeze the workload/configuration suite, references, shapes, formats and numerical policy before evaluation.
obligations.assessment: The original source and archived manifest match exactly. Eight fixed workloads use the three accepted matmul shapes and batch-16 16-to-8-to-4 model in FP16/BF16. Compiler roles, actual include-path probes, generated hardware maps, PERF=1 SimX backend, TFR tensor and STD scalar arithmetic, RV64 p02-tfr geometry and original fixtures are checked by replay; no numerical bound or golden is loosened.

obligations.requirement: Retain warm-up, repetition, synchronization, sample ordering, failures and exclusions.
obligations.assessment: Each of eight workloads has one retained warm-up followed by five measured fresh processes, one iteration each. All 48 processes and 72 launches passed; 40 processes and 60 launches contribute to measured statistics. Every declared sample, completed wait, close and actual device release is retained, with no outlier removal or failed-sample salvage.

obligations.requirement: Record cycles and computation-related observations with their correct scope.
obligations.assessment: Raw begin/end snapshots independently subtract to whole-context active-core cycles and retired macroinstructions. Corresponding FP16/BF16 workloads have 5952/509, 6339/559, 6405/2208 and 18189/3226 cycle/instruction pairs. Model totals include all three launches; no per-stage latency or physical-throughput interpretation is approved.

obligations.requirement: Record transfers and distinguish useful payload, poison, control and modeled memory traffic.
obligations.assessment: Native dispatch has two input writes, one destination-poison write and one read per launch. Independently rebuilt accounting distinguishes input/poison/output bytes, 56 argument bytes per launch, allowed host bridge/assembly and checked 64-byte modeled external requests. Useful tensor bytes and modeled traffic are not equated.

obligations.requirement: Record cache/local-memory use, availability and counter lifetimes.
obligations.assessment: Every sample retains 45 counter identities and raw values, with 33 available and 12 disabled L2/L3 counters explicitly null. Instruction/data-cache requests and misses, local-memory reads/writes/bank stalls, coalescing and external-memory observations are retained. Local-memory rows are valid measured zeros. Cache-port bank counters that reset per launch were excluded before execution; included counters are checked monotone without guessed wrap/reset.

obligations.requirement: Record and check useful computation counts and arithmetic convention.
obligations.assessment: Independent shape/dispatch reconstruction gives 256, 512, 2048 and 2560 MACs, or 512, 1024, 4096 and 5120 useful FLOPs per corresponding workload. Dense execution is retained even for zero fixture values; one multiply plus one add is two FLOPs. Host ReLU/conversion/assembly counts remain separate.

obligations.requirement: Successful counter collection cannot substitute for numerical correctness or cleanup.
obligations.assessment: All original output words match the frozen independent fixtures: 4608 native output-word comparisons, 768 packed bridge-word comparisons and 768 final assembled-output comparisons, including warm-ups. Measured-only counts are 3840/640/640. Live bridge inputs, stage weights, dispatch shapes and event statuses are checked separately. Declared host work is explicit; no silent CPU arithmetic fallback or unclosed device context is accepted.

obligations.requirement: Bind execution to exact source, tools, configuration, original bytes and externally observed producer.
obligations.assessment: External artifact IDs, SHA-256, size, source, workflow run 44901052221 attempt 1 and successful FP16/BF16 jobs reconcile. Original ZIP bytes remain unchanged. Re-executed source audit matches 786 main-repository, 50 Ramulator, 7 SoftFloat, 99 spdlog and 37 yaml-cpp bodies in each packet, all top-level gitlinks and clean source tree 6e96c99cc5a26bfacf398cd263b71f1d6ec7aab2. Replay validates all 45 command receipts per format plus unchanged source/tools/dependencies/build bindings. FetchContent and unverified-nested-link boundaries remain explicit.

obligations.requirement: Honor frozen jobs, memory, disk, logs and timeouts during actual execution.
obligations.assessment: Archived execution uses jobs=2, 4 GiB polled process-group RSS, 15 GiB minimum free disk, 16 MiB logs, 1800-second build and 180-second run deadlines. Initial available memory exceeded 15 GB and free disk exceeded 86 GB; all commands exited zero with cleanup_complete=true. The monitor is a polled budget, not a cgroup guarantee.

obligations.requirement: Provide reproducible manifests, raw samples and correct analysis with uncertainty/limits.
obligations.assessment: The reviewer reran the complete analyzer and independent measurement auditor from original digest-pinned archives. Both outputs exactly reproduce retained reports. Raw numerical/counter/host records and measured-only count/min/max/median/population-standard-deviation summaries reconcile. All six counter sets per workload are identical; varying host durations are preserved. Ratios retain exact operands and unavailable handling. The supervisor-delay caveat bars fine-grained host speedup conclusions and retrospective subtraction.

resolved_findings.assessment: Disjoint model create+advance+close is bounded by exact process-receipt nanoseconds plus unchanged 1000 ns; originals retain ample margin.
Disjoint successful stage submit/wait/compare/close and bridge/assembly scopes are bounded by accumulated advance; overlapping event/observer times are excluded.
Fraction(str(duration)) preserves the exact retained decimal and the same allowance; independent 130000 ns acceptance /130001 ns rejection regressions cover both guards and formats.

nonblocking_observations.assessment: Retain uncorrected host durations and the reproduced supervisor delay; use modeled counts for this baseline and do not infer fine host speedups.
All retained bodies are checked. Historical FetchContent tag immutability, exhaustive system-input capture and three unrelated nested CVFPU gitlinks are not independently established.
Frozen execution serializes and closes operations. Future resident-context or concurrent-queue experiments require separate ownership/launch-serialization qualification.

limitations: Acceptance is only P06-A01 at simulated evidence level for original source 84b6ca0ca75fba248ba330642bbf8764db3d459c. Review replay is not a new native execution; the candidate validator/analyzer changes do not inherit a new-source native or full-host-suite result.

The configuration is RV64 p02-tfr SimX timing-model execution, one cluster/core, four warps of four threads, issue width one, FP16/BF16 inputs and FP32 output. No processor RTL, AFU emulation, physical FPGA or silicon result is established here.

Every invocation uses a fresh process and device context. The retained warm-up does not establish warm device caches, resident weights, reused allocations, multiple live operations, concurrent queues, or steady-state throughput.

Whole-context active cycles include all model launches and are not synchronized model latency or per-kernel timing. Macroinstructions are not FLOPs; overlapping stall counters cannot be summed as an elapsed interval.

Logical tensor payload, destination poison, argument payload and modeled 64-byte memory requests have distinct boundaries. They do not establish physical bandwidth, a tensor roofline, measured DMA traffic, or physical memory capacity.

Twelve disabled L2/L3 counters are unavailable, not zero. Included local-memory counters are measured zero in this suite. Per-launch-reset cache-port bank counters are deliberately excluded from whole-context totals.

Host process duration includes supervisor exit-observation/cleanup, startup, instrumentation, numerical checks and allowed host work. A reachable approximately 100 ms monitor delay is documented; exact historical exit timestamps are absent and no delay is subtracted retrospectively.
Five measured repetitions support the retained descriptive statistics only; no outlier is removed and no production tail-latency, confidence-interval, causal bottleneck or optimization claim is made.

The model includes declared host ReLU, exact format conversion and row assembly. Only its three matrix operations are dispatched through the native runtime; this is not proof of an entirely device-resident model.

Source audit checks all 979 retained bodies and all five top-level gitlinks per format. Three unrelated nested CVFPU gitlinks were not fetched, no retained body falls under them, and FetchContent historical tag immutability is not established. Exhaustive system/build-input retention and toolchain origin are not independently proved by source-byte matching.

P06-A02 and P06-A03 remain unaccepted; P06 remains in progress. The inherited 267 to 283 DSP area finding and P01-A03 vendor XRT hw_emu blocker remain unresolved and unwaived. No synthesis, resource closure, power, energy or physical speed claim follows.

The original 2401-test hosted result and six successful workflows belong to 84b6ca0ca75fba248ba330642bbf8764db3d459c only. Other workflow successes do not grant P05 or unrelated acceptance. Publication and the full candidate-source host suite are integration-owner work.
